name: qa-automation-playwright-k6
description: QA automation: Playwright UI tests (PrestaShop demo), OpenStreetMap REST API tests and a k6 load test

scripts.test: npm run test:api; api=$?; npm run test:ui; ui=$?; npm run -s report:build; report=$?; [ $report -eq 0 ] && echo 'Allure report: allure-report/index.html'; [ $api -eq 0 ] && [ $ui -eq 0 ] && [ $report -eq 0 ]
scripts.report: npm run report:build && allure open allure-report
scripts.report:build: allure awesome test-results/ui/allure-results test-results/api/allure-results --single-file --output allure-report --report-name "QA automation: PrestaShop UI and OpenStreetMap API" --group-by epic,parentSuite,suite,subSuite
